item.title: About
item.description: The Blacksburg Museum and Cultural Foundation preserves the region’s stories through museum operations, exhibitions, education, and community engagement. We care for the Alexander Black House and St. Luke & Odd Fellows Hall, sharing local history and cultural heritage with visitors and learners.

item.title: Event Rental
item.description: Event rental information covers available spaces, capacity, rental policies, and booking details. Contact the museum to reserve a room for your next event.

item.title: Upstairs
item.description: The upstairs galleries feature rotating exhibitions and curated displays that highlight local history, art, and cultural programs. Explore this upper-level space for changing installations and interpretive exhibits.

item.title: Visitor Info
item.description:
Visitor information includes museum hours, accessibility details, directions, and location-specific guidance to ensure a safe and welcoming experience.

  • Hours available upon request
  • Accessibility accommodations available
  • Guided and self-guided tour options
  • Group visits welcome

item.title: Volunteer
item.description: Volunteers play a key role in museum operations, visitor services, and event support. Learn about opportunities to contribute your time and skills to our exhibitions and programs.

item.title: Bibliography
item.description: The bibliography page lists primary and secondary sources used in our exhibitions and research. It is a resource for students, historians, and anyone interested in local heritage.

item.title: Calendar
item.description: Our calendar highlights exhibition openings, special programs, and public events. Check back often for new updates and seasonal activities.

item.title: On the Lawn
item.description: The lawn area hosts outdoor exhibitions, community programs, and seasonal events. This outdoor space allows visitors to engage with the museum across landscaped grounds and public displays.

item.title: Sponsor
item.description: Sponsorship helps fund exhibits, education programs, and community initiatives. Discover how your organization can support the museum and amplify its impact.

item.title: Children's Gallery
item.description: The Children’s Gallery offers family-friendly exhibits, interactive displays, and programs designed to engage young visitors with history and the arts.

item.title: Donate
item.description: Donations help maintain exhibitions, educational programs, and historic preservation efforts. Learn how your contribution supports the Blacksburg Museum and Cultural Foundation.

item.title: Featured Artist
item.description: The featured artist section celebrates local and regional creators whose work is on view in our gallery spaces. Discover their stories, creative process, and exhibition themes.

item.title: Visit
item.description:
Plan your visit to the Blacksburg Museum and Cultural Foundation.

  • Phone: 540-443-1600
  • Email: info@blacksburghistory.org

We welcome visitors interested in guided tours, research, and local history programs. Please contact us for the latest hours and exhibition information.
